The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match. Discord: http://discord.gg/2qkVVan724 == Format == * Sunday August 20, 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}} * Group stage ** 4 groups - ''all groups play simultaneously'' ** 6-8 players per group ** Top 3 players proceed to grandfinal ** 4 Maps: '''AEROWALK CHUTE ZERG BRAVADO''' * Final ** 9-12 players ** 4 Maps: '''BLOODWALK CMT4 FORSAKEN GMDM1''' === Results=== {{Box|start|padding=0.2em|padding-bottom=1em}} * Grand Final {{PrizepoolSEnoprize |number=4 |width= |playerwidth=140 |bronzematch= |p1=Milton|f1=fi |p2=Gamer|f2=fi |p3=TiMMi|f3=no |p4=Bernkaoch|f4=fr }} {{Box|break|padding=5.0em}}
